dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Welcome back, Daniel. 您这次和家人出去，行程还顺利吗？

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: 挺顺利的，大家都喜欢沿途的小镇，没有把行程排得太满。Getting away from business calls was probably the nicest part.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: 听起来休息得不错。关于以后安排投资组合检视，您比较希望我们先发邮件约时间，还是直接打电话联系？

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Email first, please. 上午常常临时有业务上的事情，下午比较容易留出时间。I'd rather have the papers ready than look for them during a call.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: My identification number is T six six eight four seven nine oh R. 我的出生日期是…… Let me give that in English: my date of birth is the seventeenth of October nineteen sixty.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you. 您现在可以照着手边的笔记说，我在听。

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: 请用限价单卖出子午线亚洲股票基金，数量是一万份，限价为每份两千五百日元。交易币种是日元，交易总金额是两千五百万。 我再看一下旁边的批注。

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Please take your time with your notes.
